stem.text: A gas is enclosed inside a cylinder which is fitted with a frictionless piston.

stem.alt: Cylinder with a gas on the left of a piston; brackets above and below the gas are labelled V1 and V2, the piston is labelled piston, and two arrows labelled p point against the piston face; a dashed outline shows the piston moved to the right.

stem.text: Initially, the gas has a volume $V_1$ and is in equilibrium with the external pressure $p$. The gas is then heated slowly so that it expands at constant pressure, pushing the piston back until the volume of the gas has increased to $V_2$.
How much work is done by the gas during this expansion?
